(ESA 2025) TEXT 1

Brazil Armed Forces launch border patrol operation

Nearly 30 thousand soldiers have been engaged

The Brazilian Armed Forces HAVE INITIATED an operation named Agatha 8 in an attempt to clamp down on crimes and irregularities that take place on national borders. This year, due to the World Cup, the measure will encompass the full length of the borders, which total over 16.8 thousand km.
Approximately 30 thousand soldiers from the Brazilian Army, Navy and Air Force, WERE SELECTED to take part in the operation, which began on Saturday (May 10). In addition, agents from the Federal Police, the Federal Highway Police and the Military Police are also employed in the states covered. Other professionals ENGAGED in the action are those from such governmental agencies as the Federal Revenue Office, the Brazilian Intelligence Agency (“Abin”), and the National Civil Aviation Agency (“Anac”). Their focus is placed on the crimes most commonly committed at the national border, such as the trafficking of drugs and weapons, smuggling, environmental crimes, illegal immigration and mining.
According to the press office of the Ministry of Defense, no date HAS BEEN SCHEDULED for the end of the operation, as it depends on the outcomes of the patrols. Operation Agatha 8 is part of a measure called Strategic Plan for Frontiers, CREATED by the federal government in 2011. Before the plan WAS INITIATED, the Brazilian government MAINTAINED contact with its ten neighbors so as to keep them informed of the employment of its military forces.
Analyze the statements about the fragments in uppercase letters in Text 1, then choose the correct option.
The underlined words in Text 1 are prepositions. About this topic, judge the statements
below as TRUE (T) or FALSE (F).

I) The preposition “from” in the second paragraph indicates origin or source. ( )
II) The preposition “in” in the second paragraph is also used for cities and countries. ( )
III) The preposition “on” in the second paragraph is also used for seasons and months. ( )
IV) The preposition “in” in the fourth paragraph is also used for days of the week. ( )
V) The fragment “depends on” in the third paragraph could correctly be replaced with “depends of”. ( )
subject: Inglês
explanation:
(B) CERTA, como os comentários a seguir comprovam:

I) The preposition "from" in the second paragraph indicates origin or source.

Correto.

Em “from the Brazilian Army, Navy and Air Force”, “from” indica origem - ou seja, os soldados vêm dessas forças.

→ T (True)

II) The preposition "in" in the second paragraph is also used for cities and countries.

Correto.

“In” é usada para locais amplos como cidades e países (in Brazil, in Rio de Janeiro).

→ T (True)

III) The preposition "on" in the second paragraph is also used for seasons and months.

Errado.

Usamos “in” para meses e estações (in July, in summer). “On” é usada para dias e datas específicas (on Monday, on May 10th).

→ F (False)

IV) The preposition "in" in the fourth paragraph is also used for days of the week.

Errado.

“In” não é usada para dias da semana; o correto é “on” (on Monday, on Friday).

→ F (False)

V) The fragment "depends on" in the third paragraph could correctly be replaced with "depends of".

Errado.

O verbo depend exige a preposição on, não of.

→ F (False)
